انتقدن (form VIII)

# اُنْتُقِدْنَ (untuqidna) /un.tu.qid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# اِنْتَقِدْنَ (intaqidna) /in.ta.qid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
